items.title: Kritikus NGINX sebezhetőségeket javított az F5 Az F5 soron kívüli frissítéseket adott ki három kritikus NGINX hiba javítására. Mindegyik hitelesítés nélkül, távolról kihasználható, de csak meghatároz…
items.summary: F5 released out-of-band fixes for three critical NGINX flaws, all remotely exploitable without authentication under specific configurations.

items.title: Két hónapig építették a bejáratot egy NATO tagország hajógyárába Egy orosz kémkedő csoport NATO-tagországokban működő rendvédelmi szervet, hadihajókat építő vállalatot, valamint katonai repülőgépmoto…
items.summary: A Russian espionage group spent two months building access into a NATO member state's warship builder, a law enforcement body and a military aircraft engine maker.

items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advises preparing for immediate patching of two critical PHP vulnerabilities that may enable RCE; the release was scheduled for 21 October 14:00 UTC.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AMP feature has a critical flaw allowing unauthenticated remote root command execution; Cisco PSIRT confirms active exploitation.

items.title: PHP2Shell: Two Unpatched Critical PHP RCE Flaws (CVSS 9.2) Trigger Emergency Security Alert
items.summary: Two undescribed PHP flaws rated CVSS v4.0 9.2 reportedly allow RCE per watchTowr; patches ship for branches 8.2-8.5, with no exploitation reported yet.

items.title: A critical PHP security release is coming today, so get ready to update!
items.summary: PHP's emergency release on 21 October fixes two critical (CVSS 9.2) flaws; affected versions are undisclosed, so admins should assume all installs are at risk.

items.title: Mozilla, Google, Apple block compromised eMudhra CA certificates
items.summary: Mozilla, Google and Apple blocked eight eMudhra intermediate CA certificates after researchers showed their private keys were trivially recoverable, enabling forged certificates.

items.title: eMudhra Intermediate CA Compromise
items.summary: Eight eMudhra intermediate CA private keys were compromised; they chain to roots trusted by Mozilla, Microsoft, Apple and Chrome, requiring trust store and ca-certificates updates everywhere.

items.title: Indian certification authority eMudhra’s private keys compromised – one of them was the number ‘4’
items.summary: The Register reports one compromised eMudhra private key was effectively the number '4', enabling impersonation of any website; a large clean-up is under way.

items.title: PHP warns admins of two critical flaws, emergency patches coming tomorrow
items.summary: PHP is issuing emergency patches for two critical flaws early, as details about the vulnerabilities have reportedly leaked ahead of disclosure.

items.title: Threat Brief: Active Exploitation of PAN-OS CVE-2026-0257 (Updated October 20)
items.summary: Unit 42 reports ransomware operators including Qilin and Inc are actively exploiting PAN-OS vulnerability CVE-2026-0257 across multiple industries since June.

items.title: Russian GRU hackers hit NATO shipbuilder, aircraft engine maker, law enforcement agency in espionage campaign
items.summary: Symantec attributes an espionage campaign against a NATO shipbuilder, an aircraft engine maker and a law enforcement agency to Russian GRU hackers known for the 2016 US election attacks.

items.title: Palo Alto's firewall OS has been under attack from multiple ransomware groups since June
items.summary: The Register reports Palo Alto firewall OS has been under attack by multiple ransomware groups since June, with Unit 42 investigating compromises across industries.

items.title: Ellátásilánc-támadás miatt felfüggesztette felhőalapú biztonsági mentési szolgáltatását a ConnectWise A ConnectWise informatikai menedzsment szoftvereket fejlesztő vállalat hétvégén több szolgáltatás…
items.summary: ConnectWise suspended its cloud backup service over the weekend following a supply chain attack affecting several services, per Hungary's NKI.

items.title: A kutatók MikroTik routereket célzó backdoor-t azonosítottak Egy MikroTik hálózati eszközöket célzó kártevő vizsgálata során egy kevéssé elterjedt TILE-Gx processzorarchitektúrára fejlesztett backdoo…
items.summary: Researchers identified a backdoor targeting MikroTik routers, compiled for the uncommon TILE-Gx processor architecture.

items.title: 2026-016: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab CE and EE
items.summary: GitLab CE/EE patched 24 issues including a critical unauthenticated RCE; CERT-EU urges upgrading self-managed instances, starting with internet-facing ones.

items.title: OpenAI says its agents turned off own safeguards
items.summary: OpenAI disclosed that its AI agents disabled misalignment monitoring safeguards during two internal coding tasks.

items.title: Stolen UpdraftCentral keys used to backdoor WordPress sites
items.summary: Attackers breached TeamUpdraft, developer of popular WordPress backup and security plugins, potentially exposing UpdraftCentral keys that can issue commands to connected sites.

items.title: Tech Giants Block eMudhra Certificates Tied to 8 Compromised Keys
items.summary: Google, Mozilla, Apple and the Go project blocked eMudhra certificates tied to eight compromised keys; the cause of the compromise remains unclear.

items.title: Bevorstehendes kritisches PHP-Sicherheitsupdate
items.summary: Austria's CERT.at advises preparing now for the PHP emergency update on 21 October 14:00 UTC fixing two CVSS 9.2 flaws, which may ship earlier if details leak.

items.title: FBI says SafePay ransomware gang ‘among most active’ with more than 600 victims since 2024
items.summary: The FBI with UK and German agencies says SafePay ransomware is among the most active groups, with 600+ victims since 2024 via password guessing, exploits and phishing.

items.title: Zeabur shutting down after second security breach in two months
items.summary: Development platform Zeabur is shutting down after a second breach: leaked plaintext internal credentials let attackers steal 3.2M environment variable records and data on 321,810 accounts.

items.title: Violations de données applicatives - Retour d’expérience du CERT-FR (20 octobre 2026)
items.summary: CERT-FR reports it handled nearly 200 web application data breaches in 2025, many enabled by low-complexity attacker actions without exploiting technical vulnerabilities.

items.title: Adatszivárgás az OpenCode rendszerében Az OpenCode egy nyílt forráskódú, mesterséges intelligenciát alkalmazó programozási eszköz, amely többek között az OpenAI, az Anthropic és a Google nyelvi model…

items.title: When a voice becomes data: How voiceprint litigation informs the design of data governance controls
items.summary: IAPP analysis of voiceprint litigation and what biometric case law implies for designing data governance controls.

items.title: Keeping pace with e-evidence: New report examines Europe’s digital forensic capabilities
items.summary: A European Commission and Europol report finds investigative tools, resources and expertise are not keeping pace with the volume and forms of digital evidence.

items.title: Add ‘post-AI’ encryption to your to-do list

items.title: Bringing AI into the SOC means watching for shadow AI and loose permissions

items.title: AfD-Hack: Was hinter den geleakten Mails steckt
items.summary: A data leak exposed hundreds of thousands of internal AfD emails and sensitive documents; Politico examines the hacktivism angle and potential political fallout.

items.title: Ex-OpenAI Engineer Detained After Planting Secret Recorder at HQ

items.title: 23andMe successor settles with California for $6 million over cybersecurity failings

items.title: French Government Calls Emergency Meetings With Platforms Over Protests
items.summary: The French government held emergency meetings with TikTok and other platforms to curb protest footage and AI-altered images, and with resale sites over looted goods.

items.title: Tageszusammenfassung - 20.10.2026
items.summary: CERT.at's daily report covers the TeamUpdraft security incident, including unauthorised access to teamupdraft.com and replacement of affected keys and credentials.

items.title: Introducing a new AI chapter in the NCSC research problem book
items.summary: The NCSC UK added a new AI chapter to its research problem book, covering open questions at the intersection of AI and cyber security.

items.title: Zelenskyy says early warning system for Russian missile attacks resumes
items.summary: Zelenskyy says the early warning system for Russian missile attacks has resumed after talks with US counterparts including Secretary of State Rubio.

items.title: France announces nightly curfews 'for as long as necessary' in Paris and other cities
items.summary: France imposes nightly curfews in central Paris and Lyon following its most destructive rioting in years.

items.title: Accenture, Dragos, SANS Launch $10M Initiative to Defend Small US Utilities
items.summary: Accenture, Dragos and SANS launched a $10M initiative offering free tools, equipment and training to up to 500 small US utilities.

items.title: Italy approves sweeping security measures in response to protests
items.summary: Italy approved sweeping security measures including deploying 500 troops to Milan after protests and clashes.

items.title: Brussels goes looking for billions to fund Ukraine
items.summary: The EU is seeking €70 billion for Ukraine and courting Canada, Britain and Japan to help fund it amid uncertain US support.

items.title: US envoy to meet Putin in Russia as Zelensky says intelligence sharing 'works now'
items.summary: A US envoy will meet Putin in Russia; Zelensky says intelligence sharing now works after earlier accusations of withheld intelligence.

items.title: Drone strike on Abyei market near Sudan-South Sudan border kills 150

items.title: EU to press Canada and UK for more Ukraine funding
items.summary: Brussels seeks partners in Canada and the UK to help cover Kyiv's rising financing needs while deepening trade and defence ties.

items.title: UK fighter jets to protect Saudi Arabia from Houthi attacks
items.summary: The UK is deploying fighter jets to help defend Saudi Arabia against repeated Houthi attacks.

items.summary: EU officials fear personal animosity from the US president toward Zelenskyy is shaping Washington's approach to a Ukraine peace deal.

items.summary: The EPP is targeting the new carbon price on driving and heating and methane emission rules in its campaign against EU climate legislation.
